verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs portal has an 'All OpenAPI Files' page at docs.rollbar.com/openapi linking a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for api.rollbar.com, tagged Item, Occurrence, Metrics and Deploy, which backs its RESTful API reference. The probe's 404s only show the spec is not at the conventional guessed paths such as /openapi.json; they do not contradict the documented spec location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec covers the full API surface (only four resource tags are evidenced), and no spec at a standard discoverable path.
